resources.string: Enter your hub\'s gateway address. Your phone needs to be on Tailscale or your home network to reach it.
Enter an https:// address, like https://homebench.example.ts.net.
You can change it later: long-press the app icon and choose Change gateway.
Check that the hub is on and your phone is connected to Tailscale or the home Wi-Fi, then try again.
The hub is reachable but the dashboard didn\'t load. Give it a minute after a restart, then try again.
The hub\'s security certificate couldn\'t be checked, so nothing was loaded. Check the gateway address.
